title: Q2 personalization program — executive summary.
subtitle: Recommendation to the Acme Co. operating committee.

sections.text: Adopt Adobe Experience Cloud as the foundation for cross-channel personalization. Begin with a 90-day pilot targeting the abandoned-cart-to-renewal journey. Measure with Adobe Customer Journey Analytics. Expand to two additional journeys in 2026 H2.
Pilot ROI target: 4× lift on the targeted journey by week 12. Conservative case: 2.5× lift. Both pencils-out positively against the $1.4M annual investment.

Three macro forces converge in 2026. First, third-party cookie deprecation removes the last shortcut for cross-site personalization. Second, generative AI changed customer expectations for one-to-one experiences. Third, the CFO's mandate for measurable AI returns means whatever we run next must close the loop on revenue.

items.text: Data quality. Mitigation: Phase 1 includes a data audit before activation.
Change management. Mitigation: weekly enablement sessions with marketing ops.
Vendor lock-in. Mitigation: standards-based integrations; no proprietary data formats.

sections.text: Operating committee approval to fund Phase 1 ($340K, 6 weeks) with go/no-go gate at week 6. Full program funding to be confirmed at the August review.
